title: Products of Nilpotent and Idempotent Matrices over Finite Local Rings
summary: Let $R$ be a finite commutative local principal ring. We study products of nilpotent and idempotent matrices in $M_2(R)$. We show that every product of nilpotent and idempotent matrices is either a product of idempotents or a product of nilpotents. We then consider IN- and NI-matrices, that is, matrices which can be written as a product of an idempotent and a nilpotent matrix in the respective orders.
